verdict.rationale: gstack documents shipping its own compiled CLI (`$B`), which fronts a persistent headless Chromium daemon that agents use for browser work. This makes it an official, first-party, agent-oriented CLI. Its scope is narrow, though: it is a browser fallback, and gstack's main interface is slash-command skills running inside host coding agents rather than a general standalone CLI. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose gstack CLI covering the skills workflows (review/QA/ship/plan), a command reference or usage docs for `$B`, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
